# pairs_glyph_boxes_2026-10-02.json), checked once by eye against a numbered overlay (vision call 1 of 2, this worker); cells cut at native
# resolution, enlarged 2x, shuffled and lettered with no labels, no reading and no key (pairs_sheets_2026-10-02.py); one Fable subagent read the
# four blind sheets (vision call 2 of 2) and returned a description and a form group per cell; unblinded here against this key. The committed
# pairs_2026-10-02_q*.png are the same cells at 1x with his labels. Two comparison cells were mis-cut (a merged segment gave the M's bowl

# No shuffled control is possible for a four-position eye decision (rule 3: a non-test of discrimination, not a negative); the class question
# of sheet 1 carries its own blind-sort statistic instead (chance that a blind 7+6 partition of 13 cells reproduces his xd/x labels: 1/1716).
